interpretation: Shared raw token logits, tokenizers, output-head dimensions, and shared neural architecture are not necessary in controlled screens. A useful attention-based source can also be inserted after seen-only admission calibration when its behavioral ABI is inferable. Current evidence favors source-specific behavioral ABI adapters into a common action/state-transition probability space followed by top-dominant probability fusion.
